_about: A kit sheet for the formula estimate (math-fallback P2, `app/formula/genshin/sheets.py`). Structure (which number buffs what, for whom, under which condition) is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's character sheets at `go_commit` (MIT), cited per effect to `pando:`/`wr:` file:lines under the `go` roots, and to gcsim's Go at `gcsim_commit` where gcsim implements the same buff. No number is written here: every value is a reference into the seeded catalogue (a talent row by label, a constellation or passive param_list by index), pinned under `pins` so a re-seed that changes one withholds the effect rather than misreading it.

conditions.label: In Bane of All Evil, his burst
Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons: 5% per stack, one more every 3s of his burst (A1)
Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall: stacks from casting his skill in succession (A4)

effects.label: Bane of All Evil: Normal, Charged and Plunging Attack DMG
A1 Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons: DMG per stack during his burst
A4 Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall: skill DMG per stack

unmodelled.what: Bane of All Evil: Anemo infusion of his Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks
unmodelled.reason: an infusion changes a hit's element, which the estimate does not model (G4); a row's own channel can be set to Anemo

unmodelled.what: Dissolution Eon: Destroyer of Worlds: a skill charge
Annihilation Eon: Blossom of Kaleidos: Energy Recharge while off-field
Transcension: Extinction of Suffering: DEF below 50% HP
unmodelled.reason: no damage effect: his hits scale with ATK

unmodelled.what: Conqueror of Evil: Guardian Yaksha: skill cooldowns
